title: No reliable independent-cycle albuminuria detection gain from a red-cell width–concentration interaction
abstract: An RDW × MCHC interaction did not establish improved concurrent albuminuria detection in an independent NHANES cycle: deltaAUROC -0.000131, paired95%CI [-0.000449, 0.000199]; deltaBrier +0.000088. Nonlinear and weighted comparisons do not support reliable incremental prediction. A bounded predictive negative result in separately sampled NHANES cycles, not a clinical-utility or causal claim.
